description: Embed a list of texts through whichever provider the solet binds to embedding_service, without naming a provider plugin. Returns one vector per input in input order, plus the provider's own model id and vector dimension on every result. inputs must be a non-empty list of non-empty strings no larger than the provider's batch limit, each within its token ceiling; the provider refuses over-limit input with an error and never truncates or falls back to another provider.
embedding_description: Generate vector embeddings from text through the solet's bound embedding service, to vectorize documents. Embed text: send a list of strings and get one embedding vector per text, in input order, with the embedding model id and vector dimension on every successful result. Refuses over-limit batches and over-long texts instead of truncating.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: data.result holds embeddings (one float vector per input, in input order), dimension (the provider's vector length) and model (the provider's model id); action_status, data, actions, error and timestamp are always present
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Report the model id and dimension with the vectors; vectors from different model ids or dimensions are not comparable.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Embeds a list of texts through the provider bound to embedding_service. generate_embeddings accepts {inputs, model?, input_type?}; the provider's model id and dimension accompany every successful result.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: error.code is the provider's own code. invalid_input: inputs is empty, not a list of non-empty strings, or over the batch limit. input_too_long: a text exceeds the provider's token ceiling. unsupported_model: model is not the bound provider's model. unavailable: the provider is not ready.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Fix inputs and retry: split a long text into windows that fit the ceiling and send smaller batches. Omit model to use the bound provider's own. For unavailable, read the provider's readiness error; never switch providers to get around a refusal.
